Shipping inline explanations without UI clutter

Inline explanation cards need to appear fast enough to feel responsive while staying out of the way of text selection, hover translation, and page scrolling.

A resilient implementation caches successful answers, cools down after failures, and keeps explanation generation separate from the base translation request to avoid unnecessary cost.

Product polish comes from predictable suppression rules, stable overlay positioning, and concise output that reads like an assistant rather than raw model completions.

This fixture intentionally mixes a valid article with lower-value user comments to verify that readability tests keep the main content isolated.
